notes.text: Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation. The result is the cPanel account's number of email accounts, including zero.

**Important:**

  When you disable the [*Receive Mail* role](https://go.cpanel.net/serverroles#roles), the system **disables** this function.

On cPanel 11.138.0.19, numeric-string count results were observed through both direct and bridged UAPI. Canonical integer strings within PHP integer bounds normalize to int; integer responses remain supported. Explicit null, missing data and noncanonical numeric strings remain rejected. No cause for the wire variation or main-account inclusion is inferred.

evidence.note: At revision 7300ef501c952c7361594150610ff4fbb4b09da0, both direct-uapi and bridged-uapi count_pops GET responses recorded numeric-string at the payload root, with successful API outcomes and payload mismatch against the pinned integer result. The immutable failed artifact SHA256 is c3b795074558ee25cbeb001d09e002efe55942a32abfaa49bc8de03f97df6f31. All 17 requests were GET; both resources remained not_started. Preserve integer output while adding only existing canonical PHP-integer-bounded numeric-string normalization for this operation. The structural evidence does not establish the exact string grammar, count value, cause of wire variation, or whether the main account is included.

notes.text: Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation. Omitting domain returns all domain-level forwarders for this cPanel account.
The result preserves the documented wire names: dest is the forwarded domain, and forward is the destination domain.
Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation. The account's main domain is returned first.
Omitting addWww and includeWildcard excludes www and wildcard addresses. Temporary domains (*.cpanel.site) are excluded unless returnTemporaryDomain is true.
Omitting select omits the select output field. When select is supplied, the documented select output identifies that domain and defaults to integer 1.
Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation.

Omitting noValidate runs the email database validation check; true skips it. Omitting skipMain includes the cPanel account's main account; true excludes it. The regex parameter filters results with a Perl Compatible Regular Expression.
